name: Seating chart
desc: Upload your attendance classes.csv (then pick a class) or any .xlsx/.csv class list, seat each name on a desk of the classroom plan, save the plan for next time, and download it as an A4 PDF. Names stay in your browser.

name: Attendance and catch-up tracker
desc: Open your school folder of classes.csv and absences.csv, tap who was away period by period, print catch-up slips and summarise attendance by reason. Names stay on your computer.
